description: Ethnic group classification stored as categorical string. Contains 30 records with no missing values. Represents three semantic categories (Chinese, Indian, Malay) appearing as six distinct values due to casing inconsistencies: 'Malay' appears as 'Malay', 'MALAY', and 'malay'; 'Indian' appears as 'Indian' and 'indian'; 'Chinese' is consistently formatted.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Unify casing variations to Title Case: 'MALAY' → 'Malay', 'malay' → 'Malay', 'indian' → 'Indian'.
[CLARIFY] Confirm the official reference list of valid ethnic categories and canonical spellings, as the observed values are explicitly noted to not constitute an approved reference list.
